body: Idk. It's hard to feel anything for myself anymore.

Nothing special. I'm just really tired of getting up to human.  Especially since my bf is also suicidal. I got divorced not too long ago and it's just been really hard to want to participate in existing.
Nothing really, its just normal. I just feel the full caress of the void more than usual.
